scope: LiveKit output switches are serialized per Room with latest-request and effect-lifetime checks. Superseded failures cannot issue a default fallback over the new device selection. A new Room does not wait for a previous Room's stuck request.
Existing output fallback and reconnect behavior are retained. Tests cover selected/default output, currently missing output, stale failure, unmount and room replacement.

Synthesized event sounds route to the selected output before starting. Missing devices fall back to default, while unsupported/denied custom routing suppresses playback. Personal/server deafen and live voice-event master changes apply without losing fade envelopes. Entrance presets retain absolute volume semantics.

Passive store listeners install only on first playback to avoid the voiceStore import cycle. Account generation, owner and voice-session changes fence pending/scheduled tones; context close also invalidates them. Delayed second tones cannot escape cancellation.

Latest-request routing handles switching A to B and back to A while B is pending. Superseded failures cannot cancel the latest route; rejected context resume or asynchronous node creation is handled without an unhandled rejection.
